proposal.reason: Primary change is a substantive overhaul of open-source validation workflows and test orchestration: dual-platform (M890P/810E) job matrices, case generation/grouping/platform profiles, runtime execution behavior (device mapping, IB env propagation, dmesg capture), HPN SDK install handling, reconciliation/reporting metadata, and large CI test-family dataset additions (including patch_omitted JSON case lists). These are CI system behavior changes, not contributor/reviewer policy or production PCCL module logic.
